title: Ned Spots a Flower Grow
checkpoint: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.

pages.text: Ned spots a small green shoot by the gravel path.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling looking down at a tiny green shoot pushing up beside a gravel path.

pages.text: The shoot pokes up from a crack in the path.
pages.illustration: A close-up of the small shoot emerging from a narrow crack between the gravel stones.

pages.text: Ned checks on the shoot each day.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling waddling up to look closely at the shoot.

pages.text: First, the shoot is short and green.
pages.illustration: The young shoot, short and plain green, with no bud yet.

pages.text: Then, a little bud forms on the top.
pages.illustration: A small, tightly closed bud appearing at the top of the taller shoot.

pages.text: Then, the bud turns a soft shade of pink.
pages.illustration: The bud now tinged with a soft pink colour along its edges.

pages.text: At last, the bud is a bright pink bloom.
pages.illustration: The bud fully open into a bright pink flower.

pages.text: The bloom stands tall by the gravel path.
pages.illustration: The tall pink bloom standing proudly beside the gravel path.

pages.text: Bees and bugs land on the bloom.
pages.illustration: A bee and a small bug landing on the petals of the bright pink bloom.

pages.text: Ned is glad the path has such a bright bloom.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling sitting contentedly beside the gravel path, looking at the bright pink bloom.
